name: pair
description: You drive. Claude navigates. A pairing mode for Claude Code where you write the code and Claude scouts, critiques, hints and writes tests.

enforce_edits.title: Block source edits while pairing
enforce_edits.description: While /pair:start is active, block Claude from editing files in the project unless they match the allowed paths.

allowed_paths.title: Paths Claude may edit while pairing
allowed_paths.description: Comma-separated bash globs, relative to the project root. * also matches across directories.
